changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0025. Add database-driven plans, features, capacity grants, user assignments, and overrides. Index review: UX_Plans_Code is the registration lookup; UX_PlanFeatures_PlanId_FeatureCode is the entitlement lookup; UX_FeatureDefinitions_Code keeps feature codes stable; IX_UserLicenseAssignments_LicenseId_Status counts active seats; UX_UserLicenseAssignments_License_User stops a second active seat for the same person; IX_LicenseOverrides_TenantId_FeatureCode is the override lookup; IX_TenantLicenses_ExpiresAt lists expiring licenses. Performance note: entitlement checks filter by plan or tenant first, then a short feature code.

changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0026. Seed plans, feature catalog, plan features, and LICENSE_MANAGE. Backfill existing licenses onto the matching plan. Index review: no new indexes; inserts use the unique plan and feature indexes. Performance note: the seed is a fixed catalog cross join, not a per-tenant loop.
